blocks.x: Bordereaux automation and settlement evidence — reconciliation effort down 74%
A European specialty reinsurer — Insurance & Risk engagement delivered by a 15-person team over 13 months, EU/UK scope, commercial model: build + managed network.

items: Ceded bordereaux arrived in 30+ formats; reconciliation consumed a 12-analyst team quarterly.
Treaty settlement disputes rested on bilateral numbers; evidence chains procedural.
Retro capacity optimization stopped early at solver ceilings.

blocks.x: We built the bordereaux engine on Forge (format normalization, auto-reconciliation with quality scoring), deployed a permissioned settlement-evidence network on Ledger between cedant, broker and reinsurer, and benchmarked retro capacity formulations in a Quanta tournament — the hybrid winner industrialized as a re-solve service.

Delivery followed the standard rhythm — Diagnose with a signed baseline, Prove with falsifiable criteria, Industrialize with staged rollouts — while the control evidence (model cards, decision replay, security tests) accumulated as artifacts of the build.

items: Energy per site down 18% — telemetry-driven optimization at 12,000 sites
EUDR due-diligence automated — compliance evidence in hours, premium channels opened
